baseline_models.focus_anchor: The articulated qilan carries the doubled salaman salaman.
baseline_models.mechanism: Articulated saying and the truce branch combine so that the verse does not merely mention peace: its sole utterance performs pacification, and repetition renews the act reciprocally.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the audible carrier and makes peace an event of saying rather than scenery.
Reconciliation opposed to war supplies the literal content and makes doubled salam a performed truce.

changed_reading.before: A report of the greeting peace repeated twice.
changed_reading.after: The utterance itself is a peace-making act renewed in reciprocal repetition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Passive qilan is followed by an exact doubling of the safety noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Qawl as indication and salam as freedom from harm make the heard formula evidence of a condition, while doubling ratifies that condition rather than merely intensifying a wish.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying as its indication makes the utterance function as evidence of the state it names.
Freedom from injury supplies the indicated state, and repetition functions as its confirmation.

changed_reading.before: Salam is a polite wish for safety.
changed_reading.after: Repeated salam audibly attests and ratifies an operative freedom from harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence removes every ordinary support of intactness: catastrophe lands, earth oscillates, solid mountains are comminuted, and their dust disperses. Against that sequence, doubled salam becomes a positive condition of non-injury after material order has failed.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from defect and harm anchors the final countercondition in the focus wording.
The severe descending event supplies the initiating hazard that final safety reverses.
Violent oscillation removes stable footing and sharpens safety as freedom from destabilization.
Pulverizing and mixing supply the destructive process applied to solidity.
Elevated solid mass supplies the ordinary image of firmness that is destroyed.
Fine scattered dust supplies the resulting loss of cohesion.
Dispersion completes the movement from solidity to disaggregation.

structural_cues: 56:1 and 56:4-6 form a causal descent from impact through shaking and pulverization to dispersed dust; 56:26 answers with an exactly doubled safety noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies catastrophe, oscillation, pulverization, dust, dispersion, and salam-as-safety; I infer an arrow from dissolved material order to verbally ratified non-injury, while a simple contrast between scenes remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The phrase supplies a tranquil greeting within a pleasant scene.
changed_reading.after: The phrase certifies an intact mode of existence precisely after every material guarantee of intactness has dissolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Companionship supplies a social body, face-to-face placement supplies reciprocal channels, and circulation supplies movement through the group. Qawl that spreads among people is thereby purified into one repeatable content: salam circulates and continuously remakes the gathering as peaceful.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies the literal social diffusion that the doubled formula channels.
Mutual peace supplies the content whose circulation maintains the group's relation.
Companionship and sustained association supply the social body in which the utterance operates.
Face-to-face orientation supplies reciprocal rather than one-directional address.
Circulation around the gathering supplies the path by which the peace-saying becomes ambient.

structural_cues: 56:16 places the occupants face-to-face, 56:17 immediately adds circulation around them, and 56:26 doubles the sole utterance like call and response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, mutual facing, circulation, spreading speech, and truce; I infer that the utterance circulates through the social geometry and maintains it, while emphatic repetition by a single unspecified speaker remains live.

changed_reading.before: Two tokens of greeting are heard in the assembly.
changed_reading.after: A reciprocal peace formula circulates through the assembly as the mechanism that sustains companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate exception turns the pair into an acoustic selection rule: discarded or corrupt speech and blame-loading speech are excluded, leaving only articulated language whose content is non-harm. Peace is therefore the positive output of a purified hearing environment.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech anchors the positive item admitted by the exception.
Freedom from harm supplies the quality required of admitted speech.
Auditory reception defines the domain being filtered.
What is thrown away and not counted supplies the excluded class of semantically null speech.
False or ugly speech supplies the excluded class of qualitatively corrupt speech.
Loading or counting sin against another supplies the excluded accusatory speech act.

structural_cues: The paired negations in 56:25 are followed immediately by illa in 56:26, so the focus utterance is grammatically heard through an exclusion filter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, two excluded speech classes, an exception, and safety-bearing articulated speech; I infer that the negation actively defines a discourse protocol, while a simpler list of sounds absent and present remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The scene happens to contain no bad talk and does contain greetings.
changed_reading.after: The scene enforces an acoustic ethic in which only speech that bears no waste, corruption, accusation, or injury can pass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reward frame can extend beyond objects to discourse: purposeful work is met not only by provision but by an audible social return, a world that answers its recipients with safety.

activation_trace.role: The uttered saying supplies the audible form taken by the return.
Freedom from harm supplies the substance of the social return.
Act-for-act recompense supplies the governing return structure.
Purposeful action supplies what the recompense answers.

structural_cues: 56:24 labels the preceding sequence recompense for what was done; 56:25-26 then specify the transformed auditory environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, purposeful work, utterance, and safety; I infer that the reward frame continues into what is heard, while the phrase in 56:24 may instead close only the preceding catalogue of gifts.

changed_reading.before: Salam is incidental background speech after the reward has been described.
changed_reading.after: Being answered by safety-bearing speech is itself an audible component of recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly values protected interiority, while the focus inventory distinguishes inward, unexpressed qawl from articulated qawl. The result is not a population without interior thought; it is a protected interior joined to a public surface whose only voiced relation is peace.

activation_trace.role: Speech conceived inwardly but not expressed supplies a private interior distinct from the heard qilan.
Articulation supplies the outward boundary whose content the verse regulates.
Non-harm supplies the sole relation permitted across that outward boundary.
Concealment supplies the first image of a sheltered interior.
Protective covering supplies a second image of preserved inwardness.

structural_cues: 56:12 and 56:23 frame the scene with shelter and protective concealment, while 56:26 specifies what crosses into audible speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed and protected interiors plus branches for inner and articulated qawl; I infer a boundary from protected thought to peace-only public speech, while the concealment images may remain purely spatial and material.

changed_reading.before: Only peaceful thoughts exist because only peace is heard.
changed_reading.after: Interiority remains sheltered and plural, but whatever crosses into shared speech is transformed into non-harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Qawl as negotiation and taslim as handing over or relinquishing meet the explicit removal of corrupt talk and blame-loading. Doubled salam can therefore mark each side releasing claims against the other, not merely wishing the other well.

activation_trace.role: Mutual parley supplies a relational setting in which claims can be closed.
Handing over and relinquishment supply the literal motion of releasing one's hold or claim.
The absence of false or ugly talk removes the verbal material that would prolong dispute.
The absence of loading sin onto another removes accusation as an ongoing claim.

structural_cues: The two absences in 56:25 precede a twofold salam in 56:26, allowing the doubling to register mutual release.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negotiation, relinquishment, excluded corrupt speech, and excluded blame-loading; I infer an arrow from no accusation to reciprocal release, while ordinary exchanged greetings remain the less juridical alternative.

changed_reading.before: Each speaker offers the other a courteous greeting.
changed_reading.after: Each speaker relinquishes accusation and claim, so peace is enacted as mutual release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary q-w-l to q-l-l mapping rather than ordinary derivation. It remains anchored at qilan, is reinforced by contextual qilla and the immediate exclusion of worthless speech, and should be rendered only as formal resonance or wordplay, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qilan is the focus token mapped secondarily to the q-l-l inventory, beside doubled salam and illa.

activation_trace.role: The packet's secondary mapping supplies littleness and scarcity, making qilan resonate as a deliberately minimal quantity of speech.
The repeated peace formula supplies the compact unit to which permitted discourse is reduced.
Contextual fewness activates the same scarcity image outside the focus token.
Discarded verbal material sharpens the contrast between abundant noise and the small remainder that counts.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies the content of speech.
changed_reading.after: Amid plenitude, discourse is deliberately scant: only the minimal repeatable unit peace, peace remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ladder sense is cross-domain and does not make salam lexically mean ascent. It remains anchored in an explicit s-l-m branch and is activated by the adjacent progression from precedence to nearness; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial mechanism suggested by the sequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of salaman can be imaged as paired means or rungs.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means to an end supplies the spatial mechanism, with doubling allowing a paired-rung image.
Repeated precedence supplies forward movement at the start of the approach sequence.
Nearness supplies the destination toward which the means leads.

changed_reading.before: Peace is the speech enjoyed after nearness has already been reached.
changed_reading.after: Repeated peace is imaged as the relational means by which precedence is converted into nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The advance-payment branch is a technical commercial sense and therefore intentionally branch-distant from greeting. It remains anchored in s-l-m and gains a visible trigger from recompense and wages; render it as an economic analogy in which the utterance is a token of delivered safety, never as the direct lexical sense in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Spoken salam follows the explicit recompense-for-work frame.

activation_trace.role: Advance payment in an exchange supplies the image of peace given now as a token of full provision.
Articulated speech supplies the medium in which that token is delivered.
Recompense supplies the exchange frame that activates the technical salam branch.
Wages and provision for work sharpen the compensation side of the analogy.

changed_reading.before: The utterance merely accompanies completed reward.
changed_reading.after: The uttered peace functions as an advance token or payout of the safety fully supplied by the reward.

strongest_changes: The 56:25-26 exception becomes an acoustic ethic that admits only non-wasteful, non-accusatory, non-harming speech.
Face-to-face placement and circulation turn the doubled formula into a social circuit that continuously maintains companionship.
The opening dissolution sequence makes salam a certification of intact existence after material guarantees of stability have failed.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserved both ordinary qawl and salam mechanisms and packet-backed branch activations that a conservative synthesis would likely drop: protected interiority, reciprocal release, q-w-l/q-l-l scarcity resonance, spatial rungs, and an advance-payment analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether salaman salaman marks reciprocal exchange or emphatic repetition by one unspecified voice.
How tightly the recompense phrase in 56:24 governs the auditory description in 56:25-26.
The scarcity, ladder, and advance-payment readings are resolvable packet activations but remain analogical rather than ordinary lexical construals.
